propositions: The epic-close bug screen's per-candidate exception handler degrades LLMUnavailableError to verdict C (unrelated) instead of propagating it, silently turning systematic provider failures into no-op caused_by bug floor checks with no signal in verdict, sidecar, or exit code.

When max_tokens is set to a larger model's ceiling (128K for sonnet) but the actual runtime model resolves to a smaller one (64K haiku), the request is never re-clamped, causing Bedrock ValidationException 400 on every screen call.
Provider error during completion verifier should block the close (nonzero exit, error naming the provider failure, ticket stays in_progress) consistent with absent-provider path, not degrade open.

LLMUnavailableError must be re-raised at both epic_bug_screen seams (warm call and fan-out in screen_candidates._row, and in run_screen before the advisory exception handler) to propagate to the close gate's fail-closed handler.
Non-provider per-candidate failures (malformed output, store errors) must continue to degrade to C; only LLMUnavailableError and its subclass LLMConfigError propagate as systemic failures.
The --force-close escape hatch must remain functional to bypass verifier and close despite provider errors.
